rule: Selected: among contiguous candidates within 0.3% at the county stage, fewest split counties, then smallest moment of inertia (see search). Counties in county_rule are whole. Elsewhere: municipalities, then precincts, then census blocks, each whole unless released (refinement_log), assigned by argmin_j |x - c_j|^2 - w_j at the unit's population centre (projection km), then boundary transfers. The block assignment file is authoritative.
